payload.reason: The evidence clearly distinguishes between the two phenomena associated with AES, confirming that it refers specifically to the estimation of smiling faces as older than neutral faces in direct age estimations, while also noting that smiling faces are retrospectively estimated to be younger.

claims.text: AES refers only to the phenomenon that smiling faces are estimated to be older than neutral faces in direct age estimations.
In retrospective age estimations, smiling faces are estimated to be younger than neutral faces.
